scientific_integrity: Analytic proof supports all parameters; accompanying finite program is corroborative. Publication priority and mathematical validation are not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns intrinsic Euclidean width of standard hypersimplices with \(2\le k\le n-2\). The centrally symmetric subcase can also follow from the known inradius, and the rank-one case was known. Unindexed priority risks remain.
title: Exact minimum Euclidean width and a quadratic phase transition for hypersimplices
